pairs: PG-13 (a few really scary dino scenes)
story: A billionaire named John Hammond builds an island park full of REAL dinosaurs, brought back to life using ancient DNA. He invites two dinosaur scientists, a mathematician, and his own grandkids for the very first tour. But when the fences go down, everyone learns the hard way that dinosaurs do not follow park rules.
trivia_title: Life finds a way! Did you know...
trivia: The T-rex roar is a mix of real animal sounds: a baby elephant, an alligator, and a tiger.
When rain soaked the robot T-rex, it started shaking on its own and got even scarier.
The velociraptor calls came from geese, an African crane, and tortoises: real animals doing very un-scary things.
Spielberg finished this movie from Poland, where he was already filming his next one, Schindler's List.
numbers: of dinosaurs in a 2 hour movie: 9 minutes of robots, 6 of computer animation

scenes: The giant gate. The torches are burning because Hammond wanted an adventure, not a zoo.
Before the T-rex shows up, watch the cup of water on the dashboard. The ripples are the warning.
The first living dinosaur. Watch Dr. Grant forget how to talk.
questions: Dr. Malcolm says the scientists asked if they COULD bring dinosaurs back, but never if they SHOULD. Should we? Why?
What if Nedry had never shut off the fences? Would the park ever have been safe to open?
Dr. Grant does not even like kids at the start. By the end he protects Tim and Lex like family. What moment changed him?
